providerChecks.label: Cloud Run log query status
providerChecks.commandShape: gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="grabit-api" AND (severity>=WARNING OR "queue" OR "confirm" OR "payment" OR "refund" OR "qr")' --project=grapit-491806 --limit=100

providerChecks.label: Sentry alert dry-run status
providerChecks.commandShape: Sentry alert rule dry-run or issue/metric alert query for API/web error-rate and payment failures

providerChecks.label: Cloudflare active WAF/rate-limit rules
providerChecks.commandShape: Cloudflare dashboard/API evidence for queue-entry challenge, booking mutation rate-limit, and macro/block rules

wafSmokes.label: Cloudflare normal-pass smoke
wafSmokes.expectedSafeResult: normal buyer-like requests pass without challenge/block

wafSmokes.label: Cloudflare suspicious challenge smoke
wafSmokes.expectedSafeResult: low-volume suspicious smoke produces managed challenge/block/rate-limit evidence
wafSmokes.safety: run from an operator machine only; stop immediately if real users are challenged or blocked

wafSmokes.label: Cloudflare booking mutation rate-limit smoke
wafSmokes.commandShape: send a low-volume dedicated-test-event booking mutation smoke with a tagged user-agent
wafSmokes.expectedSafeResult: booking mutation rule records challenge/block/rate-limit without affecting real buyers
wafSmokes.safety: dedicated test event only; never target the real Girl Rules event or real users

businessMetrics.label: queue length
businessMetrics.source: Valkey queue sorted sets + QueueService snapshots
businessMetrics.commandShape: read waiting queue cardinality and active admission set for dedicated test performance
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: queue length is finite, decreasing under admission, and linked to dedicated test performance only

businessMetrics.label: queue admission rate
businessMetrics.source: QueueService admission records + Cloud Run queue logs
businessMetrics.commandShape: query admitted/session state changes and admission token success counts
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: admissions continue while remaining seats exist and no queue admission stuck state appears

businessMetrics.label: lock success rate
businessMetrics.source: BookingService lock-seat response and Valkey lock keys
businessMetrics.commandShape: compare lock-seat attempts, 2xx responses, and {showtime}:locked-seats count
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: lock success/failure matches available seats and no duplicate seat lock appears

businessMetrics.label: prepare success rate
businessMetrics.source: ReservationService prepare records and reservation status counts
businessMetrics.commandShape: count prepare attempts, PENDING_PAYMENT reservations, and rejected validation rows
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: prepare success matches valid admitted sessions and owned locks

businessMetrics.label: confirm success rate
businessMetrics.commandShape: count confirm attempts, DONE payments, reservation CONFIRMED rows, and compensating cancels
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: payment confirm success always has matching reservation, sold seats, and QR issuance

businessMetrics.label: payment success/failure
businessMetrics.source: Toss test/live dashboard, Cloud Run payment logs, payments table
businessMetrics.commandShape: compare Toss status, local payments.status, webhook ledger, and failed/canceled rows
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: payment failure spike is absent; failed payments remain recoverable or canceled safely

businessMetrics.label: QR issuance
businessMetrics.source: QrTicketService, tickets table, complete page, My Page reservation detail
businessMetrics.commandShape: count active tickets for confirmed reservations and verify visible QR surfaces
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: each confirmed paid reservation has exactly one active QR ticket visible to the owner

businessMetrics.label: refund job failures
businessMetrics.commandShape: query retryable/failed refund jobs and latest provider-safe cancel result
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: refund/cancel backlog is zero or within reviewed retry policy

businessMetrics.label: remaining seats
businessMetrics.source: QueueService remainingSeats + seat inventory DB aggregation
businessMetrics.commandShape: compare total capacity, sold/disabled/held_cancelled seats, and active locks
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: remaining seats never goes negative and matches public/queue state

businessMetrics.label: sellout behavior
businessMetrics.source: QueueService, BookingService, performance/showtime state, public booking UI
businessMetrics.commandShape: verify no more admissions/locks/prepare once remaining seats reaches zero
businessMetrics.expectedSafeResult: sellout blocks new booking side effects and keeps existing confirmed reservations intact

redactionPolicy: No raw Toss keys, payment keys, QR tokens, cookies, bearer tokens, OTPs, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, full IPs, or PII.
Cloudflare normal-pass and suspicious challenge/block/rate-limit smokes are recorded separately.
Non-PASS monitoring evidence stays non-PASS until owner approval is explicitly recorded in the Gate Ledger.
